trades.rationale: Fundamental (the why): Adobe is a category-defining software franchise with 61.9% ROE, 34.8% operating margin, and $9.3B in annual FCF — yet trades at fwd P/E 8.62 and PEG 0.59, pricing in near-permanent disruption that is not materializing. Revenue growth of 12.9% and positive EPS revisions (+0.6%) suggest the business is stable. At 27% of 52-week range, most bad news appears discounted. FCF yield of ~10% provides a hard valuation floor. Technical (the when): SMA50 slope turned positive (+1.6%/20d) after months of decline — the trend is shifting from Stage 4 decay toward Stage 1 base. Price at $238 is at 27% of 52-week range (low-risk entry by range-position standard). ATR-based stop at 2x ATR ($15.24) gives a clean $220.76 stop with 3.5x reward-to-risk. Earnings not until Dec 9 (57 days) removes binary event risk during the base-building phase. Risk acknowledged: still below both SMA50 (~$257) and SMA200 (~$256) — this is a basing entry, not confirmed breakout. Position sized at ~22% of equity so worst-case stop hit costs ~1.5% of total portfolio.
trades.exit_plan: Exit thesis-break conditions: (1) price closes below $218 on volume (base failure); (2) revenue growth decelerates below 8% at next earnings (Dec 9); (3) management signals pricing pressure in AI segment. Time stop: reassess if no progress toward SMA50 reclaim within 8 weeks. Partial profit-taking at $265 (SMA50 reclaim zone) — trim 30% to lock gains and let remaining position ride toward $290 target. Hold past 1-year mark if thesis intact for LTCG treatment. Do not add to position unless price confirms above SMA50 with volume.
